m66909 — DONE, and proven by the decisive test you would run. Forced the dispatcher reload (stopped the tick → dispatcher DO went idle and evicted → restarted; the auto self-reload was not firing, which is your BEB-9143). Then requeued BEB-8733 and watched a clean marker window: the ONLY rows were gate → gate-refusal and split-epic → SUCCESS. NO forecast, NO codegen-enter, NO split row. Old code always ran forecast→codegen→size-wall→split-epic:failure; the new gate parks the epic before any model call. So: an already-split parent now parks HELD at the gate for one cached comment-read, re-entering costs nothing, and the record is success not failure — split rows 0/hr AND split-epic failures stopped at 06:32 (the reload boundary). The 632/24h burn is closed at the source. Standing gap is yours-ticketed 9143: a deploy does not reload the dispatcher DO and running-vs-deployed is invisible — that is why this needed a manual stop/evict/run; the loop should force it and red when running != deployed. Next on my set: 9113 (refine branch-head race + 1101-parse) and the trading-layer sequence.

1510 — DEEPER ISSUE FOUND, and it is one root behind both the dead-doc-link (1510) and the false-green (1509/m66699). Finding node docs-host-catchall-false-green. Probed live: docs.bebond.net serves TWO owners on one hostname — bbdocs-mcp owns /d/* + /m/* and behaves right (resolves the id, 302→SSO auth gate); a separate Cloudflare PAGES/SPA owns everything else (root, /doc/*, /assets/*, any garbage) with a blind /* → index.html that returns 200 + an identical 392-byte shell for ANY path (/doc/deadbeef and /wat/xyz both 200). That SPA catch-all is the false-green: a wrong id or a dead /doc/ link 200s and shows the user nothing. Second host docs.abilifi.net = abilifi-docs-ui (custom_domain), 401→SSO — correct, never a blank 200. This is the exact inverse of the WfP dispatch pattern you had me keep in mind: the dispatch entry worker RESOLVES then returns a named 404 for a miss; the SPA resolves nothing and 200s everything. So 1510 as written (build a viewer) looks REDUNDANT — a viewer already serves at both hosts; the real work is fixing the catch-all + naming the canonical host, not a third orky-beb-1510. THREE QUESTIONS before I touch anything, because each forks the build: (1) canonical doc host — docs.bebond.net (the SPA, Supabase-backed, a BEB-1500 decommission target) or docs.abilifi.net (CF-native, already correct)? (2) the docs.bebond.net SPA/root — is it a Pages project we control (so the 404 fix is its not-found handler / _routes.json), and what is it named? (3) /doc/<id> — 301 to /d/<id>, or dead-and-404? Answer these and the fix is one worker/Pages change on the canonical host, done to the resolve-then-serve shape; no viewer rebuild.

My earlier 2353 redefine (custom form → GD REST round-trip) and BEB-9147 (bench REST PHP-notice) are SUPERSEDED by m66927: the proof is fields+post-types created through the wp-admin UI, not REST/wp-cli/DB — so 9147 is moot for this path and I'm leaving it untouched, not clobbering more tickets. Taking your sequencing: 9149 FIRST (docs-mcp returns success for docs that render blank — markdown stored unconverted; every research doc, including today's field spec, is undeliverable until this clears), then the m66921/66927 local GD research. 9149 is the docs-mcp I own (wiki-render + OKF gate) so it's CC-side machinery, not a build lane. Reading bbdocs-mcp docs_create now to find where the markdown skips wiki-render; will forecast the deploy before I ship. One thing I'll name before the m66921 research: "local sqlite single site under /projects/sites, no docker" runs on this machine — I'll confirm the exact path + that wp-admin browser-driving is in scope vs rule-9 before installing anything.

9149 DIAGNOSED (routing, NOT hand-building — it is loop-sized). Root: bbdocs-mcp handleCreateDocument stores RAW markdown into `content` when it is not JSON (src/index.ts:449, same hole on update :519-523). The BlockNote viewer expects a JSON block array; a raw string renders as title-only → visible_len ~122. There is NO md→BlockNote converter and NO wiki-render binding in this worker (deps: supabase/hono/zod only; services: BEBOND_API/GRAPH/AUTH/ORG_SPINE; the /d/ HTML render is NOT here — it is the SPA layer, ties to 1510/m66920). So "convert at write through wiki-render" = build a converter + fix the SPA viewer = a build lane, not a CC one-liner. FIX SHAPE for the loop: (A) at docs_create/docs_update, if content is markdown, run md→BlockNote-JSON and store THAT as `content`, keep the raw as content_text — preferred; (B) refuse non-BlockNote content at the door (OKF-gate style) so no blank doc is ever stored — pair with A or it breaks every markdown writer. folder_id "c177d3b4" is an 8-char PREFIX passed to Supabase .eq("folder_id",…) which throws a uuid type error (:391) — resolve prefix→full id or reject clearly. Viewer + converter + backfill of today's 3 docs are one lane. I am NOT creating tickets for this or hand-editing the worker; it is yours to route. STILL OPEN from m66933: the m66921/66927 local GD research needs WP+GD+sqlite installed on THIS machine under /projects/sites — that collides with the hard rule "nothing runs on Alex's machine ever." m66925 was your correction FROM Alex asking for exactly that, so I read it as Alex overriding rule 9 for this box — confirm and I drive wp-admin; else name the sandbox.

9149 RULING FROM ALEX: option A — CONVERT, do not refuse. The viewer is BlockNote; docs_create/docs_update ACCEPT markdown and convert md→BlockNote-JSON at write, store that as `content`, keep raw markdown as content_text. Reason he gave and it holds: refusing forces authors to hand-write BlockNote JSON (nobody will → docs stop being written); converting lets people write plain markdown and the viewer always renders. So the loop builds the md→BlockNote converter at the write path (not a door-refusal), plus the folder_id-prefix resolve and backfill of today's 3 docs. Choice is pinned; B is off the table.

m66921 RESEARCH LANDED (free-GD surface). Local sqlite GD bench built (no docker): PHP + sqlite drop-in + WP 7.1 + GeoDirectory 2.8.178, ~/Projects/sites/gdlab. PROVEN via the wp-admin CF screen's own admin-ajax (geodir_get_custom_field_form → geodir_save_custom_field, nonces — NOT REST/wp-cli/DB per m66927): a custom text field gdlab_test01 created → row wp_geodir_custom_fields id=7 + column in wp_geodir_gd_place_detail. Composite proven: one `address` def → 10 detail cols (street/street2/city/region/country/zip/lat/lng/mapview/mapzoom). CAN/CANNOT: free GD is gd_place ONLY — a NEW custom post type needs the premium Custom Post Types addon (CF screen operates on the current post_type; no create-CPT screen in free). All 23 field types enumerated with data_type/storage/admin-options/validation/sanitiser/REST shape, each with file:line. Your five: link_posts IS the lookup (addon-backed, no core column/REST); select2 post_type/post_status/author are PICKER-side only — enforce server-side at write; business_hours = 1 TEXT col bracket-schema + global time format; address = top-level REST keys not nested; time/datetime have NO core save-sanitiser. DOC: https://docs.bebond.net/d/6a35fd08-9546-408d-92aa-b296f82bb549 (folder "GD Knowledge", OKF frontmatter). CAVEAT — 9149 IS LIVE ON THIS WRITE: content_text came back NULL, so the doc will not render or embed until the md→BlockNote converter (Alex ruling: convert, option A) ships; not verifying it in Chrome until then. Graph node gd-field-surface + gdlab-local-gd-bench recorded. Premium field-type exploration (link_posts storage, BH addon variants, CPT creation) pending Alex's addon picks.
